fact: INSBU's account of the Groupe Sectoriel Statistique meeting of 28 July 2026 refers to the SNDS-III as the national statistical development strategy in force; no period is given, and the date is that of the meeting.

The statutory Groupe Sectoriel Statistique meeting of 28 July 2026 discussed the recommendations of the mid-term evaluation of the SNDS-III, which shows that evaluation had reported; the completion date is not given, so the meeting date is used.
PARIS21's January 2026 NSDS status table lists the strategy as implementing (adopted): NSDS 2022-2026.
